prompts.name: cosmic-backdrop.webp
prompts.prompt:
Use case: background-extraction / style-transfer.
Asset type: seamless repeating ambient background texture for The Fold gothic tarot website.
Input image: the existing approved hero-clean.png is the exact palette, cloud, grain, and star reference. Create a new companion backdrop derived from its atmosphere; do not redesign the existing hero.
Primary request: transform the reference into an understated, all-over deep aubergine/violet cosmic nebula texture with tiny warm gold pinprick stars. This will sit behind the entire webpage and fill every gap around the other artwork. The atmosphere must continue naturally in both horizontal and vertical directions.
Composition: 2048 x 2048 square seamless tile; organic fine smoky wisps and diffuse cloud filaments across the entire canvas, including the center; soft non-directional mottling at every edge. Top and bottom edges match, left and right edges match. Uniform overall luminosity, no obvious central subject, no vignette, no empty solid-black patches, no bright center or stripe. Subtle medium-small texture detail that stays crisp when scaled.
Palette: near-black plum #0b0712, deep muted violet #211326 and #34213d, restrained dusty mauve glows #55364f; very sparse antique-gold and warm ivory tiny stars. Dark elegant atmosphere with enough visible cloud detail to replace flat black page margins. No neon, no blue-dominant space, no pure white highlights.
Remove all moons, large star flares, eyes, rings, ornaments, mountain silhouettes, horizon, water, borders, cards, panels and text from the reference; keep only its matching violet celestial atmosphere. No lettering, logos, UI, watermark, frame, symmetry, hard bands, or repetitive geometric motifs. This is a finished texture asset, not a website mockup.
